tasting_note.appearance: Pale ruby with light brick highlights and rapid tearing.
tasting_note.nose: Subdued dark plum, cedar shavings, dried thyme, and subtle baking spices.
tasting_note.palate: Light-bodied and linear on entry, framed by measured, well-integrated acidity and supported by soft, rounded, accessible tannins.
tasting_note.finish: Crisp, refreshing finish (10.0% ABV) characterized by clean tart red fruit and dried herbs.

food_pairings.dish: Spicy Red Thai Curry & Sichuan Noodles
food_pairings.pairing_rationale: Light body and low perceived heat prevent burning capsaicin friction on the palate.
Delicate red fruit and brisk acidity flatter the rich omega-3 oils without metallic clash.
Complex nutty curds mirror the wine's rich extract and ethanol warmth.
Vibrant acidity cuts through duck fat while ripe red fruit accents savory spices.
Ample tannins and bold structure effortlessly cut through marbling and rich umami.
